subject.title: test(ai): freeze Responses stream processor parity

question: Should this maintainer-labeled migration-preparation PR be accepted as the approved behavioral baseline for consolidating the two private Responses stream processors?
rationale: The PR deliberately records several existing divergences as canonical or known legacy behavior; deciding which of those outcomes must survive the later consolidation is an owner-level contract decision, and the protected label requires explicit maintainer handling.

options.title: Approve the parity baseline
options.body: Confirm that the fixture expectations and explicitly named divergences accurately define the intended pre-consolidation behavior.

options.title: Narrow or revise the baseline
options.body: Request changes to any fixture whose expected output would preserve a known bug or incorrectly treat a legacy behavior as canonical.

recommendation.title: Approve the parity baseline
recommendation.body: Confirm that the fixture expectations and explicitly named divergences accurately define the intended pre-consolidation behavior.
